Males have a prominent shaggy mane ranging from blonde to dark brown surrounding the head and neck. Coat is short, dense, and uniform tawny with a lighter underside. Body is large, muscular, and well-proportioned with powerful legs and a long tail with a dark tuft at the end. Head is broad with a short muzzle. Ears are small, rounded, and erect. Eyes are medium-sized, round, and amber to brown with an intense expression. The breed's signature features include the male's distinctive mane, social pride behavior, and tawny coat with tail tuft.
